title: Security hygiene follow-ups: export filename sanitiser, dead db.tcpServer config, WAR session cookie HttpOnly

criteria.given: an export endpoint whose filename comes from a request parameter (chart, xls, csv, pdf, admin download)
criteria.then: the Content-Disposition header is built by ContentDispositions, which strips everything outside letters, digits and . _ - space, quotes the filename and adds an RFC 5987 filename* form
the unread db.tcpServer=-tcpAllowOthers context-param is gone

criteria.given: a WAR deployment without the launcher's cookie hardening
criteria.then: web.xml declares the session cookie HttpOnly
